title: Dubai Developed in Fortnite 2033 is now live: DMCC promo video 'The Dubai Fortnite map is live'
status: scheduled in Publer 13:45Z (17:45 Dubai) Instagram, X, Threads; QC pass
why: The island announced for 11 Nov is now live per DMCC's own promo video; regional story, update to the 9 Nov Reel.

sources.name: DMCC promo video 'The Dubai Fortnite map is live' (file sent by Mohammad, 12 Nov)

first_report: DMCC release 2 Nov 2026 announced the 11 Nov launch; the promo video saying the map is live reached us 12 Nov. Update to our 9 Nov Reel (published), nothing new on the web found live status, so the live claim rests on the DMCC video only.
footage: Mohammad's file: DMCC promo, 1280x720, 14.7 s, near silent audio (-42 dB mean), burnt-in headline, DMCC and Dubai logos. Searched DMCC site, Wild Unlimited, Epic, Tbreak, Whats On, WAM, ARN: no video, no better copy. Showcase layout keeps the burnt-in text whole.

claims.text: The Dubai Fortnite map is live (promo video text)
Explore Dubai Developed in Fortnite 2033 and discover DMCC in-game (video text)
Built by Wild Unlimited in UEFN, ten landmarks
Independent island, not sponsored, endorsed or administered by Epic Games

gate: gate 12:50Z: DMCC video read frame by frame (text), DMCC release and Tbreak read earlier on 9 Nov, news search 12:40Z for the island code or a denial found none and no outlet reports live status yet. Exit A for the live claim from the DMCC video itself; island code and platforms not stated, not claimed.

angle.hook: The Dubai Fortnite island is now live, says DMCC
angle.why_now: Launch day was 11 Nov; DMCC promo went out saying the map is live
angle.what_it_means_here: Ten Dubai landmarks playable worldwide in Fortnite; independent island by Wild Unlimited, not Epic's
angle.payoff: Epic neither sponsors nor runs it
